node.title: PMA sigma-one paired-core abundance obstruction
node.statement: The exact first moment of the number A(U) of paired (k-1)-cores is E A(U)=binom(n,k-1)(2M+1)!/(2^M M!)(q)_{M+1}/q^{2M+1}. At the valid official rate-half cyclic row (q,n,k)=(65537,65536,32768), this mean is greater than n^6, so some word has more paired cores than the entire primitive allowance. This does not count Post extras: it route-cuts a bare unweighted core census and forces a weighted Post-carrying estimate, empty-core classification, or chart-free owner.
